content.title: The Director of ‘Hamnet’ on the Oscars and Her Midlife Crisis | The Interview
content.text: Chloé Zhao’s latest film, “Hamnet,” has received eight nominations for the 2026 Oscars, including for best picture, best director and best actress (for Jessie Buckley’s lead role). This is the second time Zhao has been in the running for an Academy Award for her directing (She won in 2021 for “Nomadland.”) Now 43, with five feature films under her belt, has established herself as one of cinema’s most distinguished and distinctive directors. But that success doesn’t make awards season easy. Zhao talks here about how she is working to overcome her deepest fears and open her heart. And she explains why a midlife crisis can be “the best thing that can happen to you.” Read more: https://www.nytimes.com/2026/01/24/ma...
